remedies of a secured party under the New York Uniform Commercial Codes (the “UCC”),
except those rights and remedies of a secured party as set forth in UCC §9-620 (°§9-620
Rights”), unless the Makers consent to grant to the Holder said §9-620 Rights, including the right
to foreclose, sell, lease or otherwise dispose of any or all of the Collateral in any manner allowed
by the UCC, including, without limitation the right to take possession, with or without prior
notice to the Makers, of all or any part of the Collateral. From the date hereof, such secured
party will also have the right to file UCC-1 financing statements (and amendments thereto)
reflecting its respective security interest in the Collateral.

The Makers shall promptly advise Holder of any Event of Default that has occurred, or
that Makers’ reasonably anticipate will occur, within forty-eight (48) hours of any such
occurrence or when Makers reasonably should have known of, or anticipated, any such
occurrence.

8. Notices. All notices, demands, elections, requests or other communications given or made
under this Note (“Notices”) must be in writing and shall be deemed properly given or made only
if delivered to the party’s addresses indicated above (or to such other address in the United States
as may be specified by Notice given as provided herein) in one of the following manners: (1) by
hand delivery, (ii) by FedEx or other nationally recognized delivery service offering overnight
delivery, or (ii) by certified mail (postage prepaid, return receipt requested). The Parties may
designate a new address for purposes of notice hereunder by giving written notice thereof to the
other party in accordance with this paragraph.

Makers acknowledge and agree that this Note has been tendered by the Makers im connection
with the satisfaction and discharge of the corporate obligation of Ophir Partners, LLC to OPEH,
LLC, in consideration of the personal guaranty of the Makers. Accordingly, in addition, and not
in limitation of, any other Notice obligations herein, the Makers, shall (a) keep Holder
reasonably apprised of the status of any anticipated sale or transfer of the Property in satisfaction
of Makers’ obligations hereunder, (b) immediately advise Holder if any one or both Maker(s)
become the subject of any governmental investigation, examination, charges, or proceedings; (c)
immediately advise Holder of any event or occurrence that will or may adversely impact
Holder’s rights and remedies hereunder; and, (d) disclose (x) this Note and (y) Makers’
obligation to pay the Holder pursuant to the terns of this Note to the title company of any
purchaser of the Property.

9. Invalidity. Any provision hereof which is to any extent invalid or unenforceable shall be
ineffective only to the extent of such invalidity or unenforceability without invalidating the
remaining provisions hereof, and each provision of this Note shall be valid and enforceable to the
fullest extent permitted by law.

10. This Note is fully assignable and transferable by Holder in Holder’s discretion, and the
assignee or transferee party shall become “Holder” for all purposes of this Note upon (but not
prior to) written notice of such assignment or transfer being given to Makers. Makers shall not
be responsible to any subsequent Holder of this Note on account of any payment made by
Makers to a prior Holder prior to receipt of notice of assignment in the manner contemplated by
the preceding sentence.

11. This Note is and shall be binding upon Makers and Makers’ estates, heirs, successors and
assigns. No assignment or delegation of any of the obligations of Makers under this Note shall
release Makers therefrom, except as otherwise agreed in writing by the then Holder of this Note.

12. It being the intent of the Parties that the interest charged herein shall comply with applicable
usury laws. As such, in the event any interest is charged and/or paid on this Note that is deemed
to be in excess of the then legal maximum rate, then that portion of the interest payment
representing an amount in excess of the then legal maximum rate shall be deemed a payment of
principal and applied against the principal of this Note.

13. This Note is governed by, and is to be construed in accordance with, the laws of the State of
New York, without reference to the conflicts of laws principles thereof. Each of the Parties
hereto and their assigns hereby consents to the exclusive jurisdiction and venue of the New York
State courts seated in the County and State of New York and the United States District Court for
the Southern District of New York with respect to any matter relating to this Note and
performance of the Parties’ obligations hereunder, the documents and instruments executed and
delivered concurrently herewith or pursuant hereto and performance of the parties’ obligations
thereunder and each of the parties hereto hereby consents to the personal jurisdiction of such
